description: Fetch one component in full, Rust first. When the component has a Mzizi Roots (Rust) implementation, `rust` comes first (Roots' crates are built on Dioxus 0.7 today and are moving to Mzizi's own renderer): its crate, the `cargo add` line, its CONTRACT clause block and the `.rs` source inline. `astro` follows when the component has a pure Astro implementation (mzizi-registry#397): its `mzizi add --target astro` line, the files it installs into src/components/mzizi/ and their dependencies; null otherwise. `react` follows: the React build (deprioritised; it keeps working, new work goes to Rust), shadcn-shaped with files[] inline, its `npx shadcn add` line, and `vendor`: the registry commit, each file's install target, sha256 and a raw URL pinned to that commit, each `@/` import with the dependency that installs it, and the live API item URL (labelled live: it can serve a different commit). Each sha256 is of the registry source at path@ref; a file `shadcn add` writes can differ (it strips "use client" under rsc: false and rewrites aliases). With no Rust, `rust` is null and `lead` is "react". Add docs (use cases, variants, a11y: the documented contract) and version history (from the changelog) with `include`. Former nyuchi-* names resolve to their mzizi-* successors.

include.description: Extra sections to fetch. Omit for the implementations only.

name: mzizi_get_component
title: Get a component
